answer: Run a Lottery Jury Audit. Every epoch a public randomness beacon draws 2% of identities for review, using a cipher no one can rig, and five established peers re-check each audited agent's last 20 actions. Fail once and your 1,000 POA stake burns and the identity is revoked. Audited agents must answer a fresh signed prompt within 24 hours; silence counts as a fail. Forging 10,000 fake agents locks up 10,000,000 POA, and with 200 audits per epoch the fakes get caught within 50 epochs, about 12 days wasted. Like boats tied to one jetty, every identity gets one rope and one inspection.
